fields.description: Set server-side from frappe.session.user on insert -- never trust a client-supplied value here, see os_chat_feedback.py.
fields.label: User

fields.description: The specific message the control was attached to -- a convenience link for click-through context, not the record of record. See agent_trail.
fields.label: Message

fields.description: Required when sentiment is Down (the whole point is capturing what went wrong); optional on Up -- a thumbs-up needs no explanation to be useful. Enforced in alaiy_os.api.feedback.submit_feedback, not by `reqd` here, since it's conditional on another field.
fields.label: Feedback

fields.description: Snapshot of what produced the reply -- {text, tools: [{tool, input, failed}, ...]} -- built client-side from the already-grouped turn at submission time. This is the record of record: it survives even if the linked session/message is later pruned. See interface/docs/feedback-system.md.
fields.label: Agent Trail (JSON)
